headline: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as markets await Federal Reserve decision
summary: Bitcoin traded near $80,400 as global markets braced for upcoming interest-rate decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan.
why: Central bank monetary policy decisions heavily influence global liquidity conditions, risk asset valuations, and cryptocurrency market volatility.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Anticipation of major central bank interest rate decisions can induce broad price consolidation or volatility in crypto assets.

why_moved: Macroeconomic uncertainty ahead of central bank rate verdicts kept investors cautious.
